text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This happened on the way back from 
shopping with Air Messiah in the shopping 
district...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
A lottery... Come to think of it, we 
received a ticket earlier, didn't we?
choice_data_list:
Since we have the chance, let's give it a 
try.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I checked when I received it, and it 
looked like the expiration date was coming 
up soon anyway.
choice_data_list:
Messiah seems like the type who'd actually 
use something like that properly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you referring to discount coupons 
and the like? Let's see—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I don't really have a strong desire for 
personal gain, but... breaking a set 
deadline makes me uncomfortable.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
For limited-time lottery tickets or 
discount coupons, I make sure to use them 
all up without being wasteful.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Back home, we even had a file for sorting 
coupons like these by expiration date. 
...Naturally, hand-crafted by Mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oops... Sorry, I got sidetracked. More 
importantly, we were talking about the 
raffle tickets.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Uncle. May I have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Oh, care to give it a spin?! Step right 
up, step right up!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Air Messiah carefully spun the 
handle of the raffle box.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! Oh my—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much. To think I'd win 
the grand prize...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievably, she actually won the 
overnight hot spring trip voucher! Talk 
about incredible luck!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to the brochure the shopping 
district folks showed me, it's surrounded 
by rich nature, making it seem like a 
peaceful getaway—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Air Messiah, who believes that "rest 
should also be valued," this should be a 
wonderful opportunity.
choice_data_list:
Go have fun with your mother and the 
others.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Let's see—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...However, from the looks of it, the 
expiration date seems to be quite far 
off."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: If that is the case, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Could you please hold onto this for a 
little while?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"So, once we've both calmed down a bit, 
let's use it together."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Rest is important." After all, that 
applies to you as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...I apologize. I may have been a bit 
overly pushy just now—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
How do you feel about it, Trainer? Like, 
um—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Does taking a trip with me sound boring to 
you?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! Wh-What was that?! That was one 
crazy loud shout, bro?!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! Wh-What was that?! That was one 
crazy loud shout, sis?!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, ahaha—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I only meant it as a joke. 
...Though you shot it down much more 
forcefully than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "However—no. Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I am looking forward to it as well.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: My, this... looks absolutely delicious.
choice_data_list: How about having this for dinner tonight?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Hmm. That sounds good too, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Do you happen to be free this weekend?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Trainer, can you hear it? The 
babbling of the river is so soothing.
choice_data_list: Yeah... It really puts the mind at ease.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"It is thanks to the alpha waves. Being 
surrounded by the sounds of nature truly 
seems to produce a profound relaxing 
effect."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Did all that hiking work up a 
good appetite for you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If it's alright with you, may I unpack the 
bento now?
choice_data_list: To think you prepared some for me too...!
You even prepared one for me...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please don't be so modest. Thanks to 
the hamburg steaks we won the other day, 
the main dish was already decided, and—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...If anything, it was more about 
fulfilling my own request.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Actually, this mountain stream was 
a soothing spot I found recently, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking for the right 
opportunity to introduce them to you 
someday, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...How was that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I emphatically pressed my point. Things 
had been a bit hectic around New Year's, 
and I knew fatigue had been building up, 
but—
choice_data_list:
Ever since coming here, it vanished 
completely!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so... That's wonderful to 
hear.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Still, isn't that a bit too much 
praise? You're exaggerating, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
How do I put this... Because you're always 
like that—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've become a bit of a 
show-off lately...
choice_data_list: Yeah, but Messiah is amazing, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: No, but you see...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —...Geez.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "This is... quite a spectacular amount."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Since we have it, it would be wonderful to 
put it to good use.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, I would be honored if you would 
enjoy this carrot dish.”

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay~~~! It's handmade by Messiah-san~♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd invite Cheval and me, too. 
Was it really alright?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, after all, they are the elder sisters 
of Vivlos-san, who always takes such good 
care of me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: However—I have one request before you eat.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh, a f-favor...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. Actually—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
All the menu items we're about to serve 
are things Trainer and I took a 'bold 
leap' to come up with.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I have always tended to stay within 
conventional boundaries... However, there 
are times when I wish to break free from 
them as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I gave it some thought for the sake of 
that training. So—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I would like each of you sisters to check 
and confirm whether that degree of 
'letting loose' was truly appropriate.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... What!? U-Ummâ!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Aha, that's classic Meji-senpai~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha for now! ♡ Bring 'em on, keep 'em 
coming~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: That was sooo yummy~♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, really! The carrot glacé had such a 
rich, buttery aroma—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh♪ Its shape was kind of funny too, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you noticed? Indeed, while decorative 
carrot garnishes are usually flowers—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
This time, to everyone's surprise, I 
boldly decided to go with... fish.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, the fish... um, were cute... 
ehehe. I ate quite a lot of it, though...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes, I was glad. ...Um, so—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
How was that? ...Did you feel it? That, 
you know... sheer eccentricity...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...! U-Umm—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list:
(Ah, she's getting smaller and smaller 
right before my eyes...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However, in any case, the party 
featuring those mildly uninspired carrot 
dishes turned out to be quite a hit."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Just one... This looks like it'd make a 
nice snack.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps I shall slice them a bit thickly 
and turn them into veggie sticks. A lovely 
accompaniment for relaxing..."
choice_data_list: So after this, it's relax time, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that was my plan once I got back to 
the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but... come to think of it, I believe 
someone might have already reserved the 
dorm kitchen—"
choice_data_list:
Want to use the cooking equipment in the 
trainer's office?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was small, but it was equipped with at 
least a kitchen knife and cutting board. I 
told Air Messiah that if it was alright 
with her, she was welcome to rest in the 
room.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My, is it really all right? Then, if 
you'll excuse me—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I have a few preparations to make, so I'll 
return to the dorms first and visit you 
again shortly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Air Messiah came from the 
dorms to the Trainer's office to enjoy 
some relaxing downtime.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she hurriedly placed down on the 
table in front of the sofa was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It even has a set of weights. No doubt 
about it—though it's a distant memory, 
it's that very same balance scale used in 
science experiments."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes. It's a balance scale—my personal 
one.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Have you ever heard the saying that 
'staring blankly at things with repetitive 
movements brings peace of mind'?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It's often said that 'watching a washing 
machine spin continuously brings peace of 
mind,' or things along those lines.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, you can't watch a washing 
machine spin unless you actually do 
laundry, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
This balance scale is what I chose as a 
relaxation item that I can use at any 
time.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seated on the sofa, Air Messiah used 
tweezers to pick up a weight and place it 
onto the balance pan lined with weighing 
paper. The scale creaked softly as it 
swayed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The scales swayed back and forth for a 
while, but as she nibbled on a carrot 
stick and watched—they eventually came to 
a stop.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After carefully wiping her hands with a 
handkerchief, Air Messiah picks up the 
tweezers again. She places a weight on the 
opposite scale pan—and balances it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu.
choice_data_list:
(...For now, it looks like she's 
relaxing.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, that's what happened. ...I 
decided to just leave it at that.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, I cannot say I am particularly 
lucky, however.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she shouldn't have had 
exceptionally bad luck... No, in a sense, 
does this mean she achieved a result 
that's off the charts...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, but... if we were going to break 
through, I wish it had been in a positive 
way.
